title: Collection
description: An ordered, curated group of a Site's landing pages with its own presentation (plans/SITE_COLLECTIONS.md). Reusable as a page section (a collection-embed) and — via the Site routing table, NEVER on this entity — optionally reachable at a path. Pure data: a Collection is URL-unaware (no slug, no `routable`). The Python validator (domain/documents.py: validate_collection) is the source of truth; this file is reference documentation.

site_id.description: The Site this collection belongs to. Its members are pages on that Site.

rule.description: How members resolve at publish: 'manual' = the explicit ordered members[]; 'all' = every offer page on the Site; 'category' = offer pages in `category`. The publisher resolves against the Site route map so a card only links to a real, navigable Site page.

members.description: Ordered page_id references (rule='manual'). Playlist semantics — references, never ownership; a page can be in many collections.
